judgements.reasoning: Ready. The stage's three exit criteria are each carried by a measurement on the final tree rather than a claim: (1) an independent pass without a direction is refused where produced (eight write-gate tests plus the CLI-surface case) and marked where it cannot be (the two independent-pass goldens; the pre-D4 boundary retained), with the gate reading nothing new (the three-readers test; trail.ts absent from the stage's diff, gates.ts's diff exactly the export keyword); (2) the direction renders in its own section inside the quarantine with the engine tail last, and walk 1 closed the one real containment hole the cycle found — a bare carriage return — in one shared splitter over all four verbatim bodies, so the single-voiced rule is tighter at archive than at apply; (3) the prompt template carries `## Direction` as a named field, installed byte-equal from the owning delta and held by the parity test. The cadence's own evidence is the strongest input: both halves of the blind pair ran under the new surface and the slot worked in both — the fresh emit's direction was accepted first time, the external return's section rendered unmarked with three parser probes inside it — and the halves DISAGREED (hold against forward), which is the slot producing two cited views where before there was prose; I read both, and the hold's three reasons were each resolved at walk 1. Nineteen system-cadence findings across three passes, zero CRITICAL, zero repeats, no mechanism authored at either walk (two scope calls by chat: 2A a wording delta, 4A a declaration). What remains is listed below: rc07's distinction, the unenforced content contract, and five riders for other owners.

accepted.claim: The review-system gate PASSED means every substantive finding is resolved — NOT that an independent pass stood clean on the final tree. The two independent passes read the apply commit 2f482e65; the two walks and the confirm edited after it (the shared splitter, the predicate swap, the placeholder clause, the ninth MODIFIED block, the openness declaration), and no fresh or external pass has read those edits.
accepted.why: rc07's distinction, carried on every rc-stage archive since. The walks' edits are each pinned by a test the confirm re-ran (2465 green), the confirm re-executed every exit-criterion measurement rather than reading the logs, and the engine merged all eleven blocks byte-equal; buying a third independent pass for five small edits would be effort targeted rather than recorded (R-crc-11(h)).

accepted.claim: The direction's CONTENT contract — which way and why; never counts, gate state or a command token — and the agreement between a direction's token and its reasoning are enforced nowhere (R-crc-10). This cycle's halves disagreed on direction, and nothing in the engine noticed.
accepted.why: By design (D-rc04b-3/4): the engine judges presence and shape; whether the direction is RIGHT is the in-context reaction's and this record's judgement — which is exactly what happened here. The engine tail rendering last is the structural backstop, and walk 1's carriage-return fix closed the one way a reasoning line could have forged it.
